## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) and VXX in RECOVERY (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) show short-term volatility while credit proxies HYG (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.34%) are BELOW TREND, supporting a neutral stance.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit stress edge higher as HYG (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.34%) and LQD (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -2.09%) are BELOW TREND → credit tightening. Commodity/energy surge via BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND is pro-cyclical; VXX (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) RECOVERY signals episodic fear.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Bond weakness: TLT (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -3.16%) BELOW TREND → yields rising; corporate bonds soft with LQD (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND. Dollar and curves neutral in the data set, leaving conditions mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities and Industrials showing strength: XLU (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +2.43%) ABOVE TREND, XLI (1W: +2.55% | 1M: +4.10%) ABOVE TREND. Tech mixed/weak: XLK (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) RECOVERY and Financials lag short-term: XLF (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +3.62%) CORRECTION — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US softening short-term: SPY (1W: -1.67% | 1M: +0.63%) CORRECTION. China showing month strength but short-term flat: FXI (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +4.96%) CORRECTION; EM mixed: EEM (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -3.83%) RECOVERY.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Bitcoin ETF strength with IBIT (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +3.79%) ABOVE TREND while thematic/spec names soft: ARKK (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND and IWM (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -1.09%) BELOW TREND; VXX (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) RECOVERY points to episodic risk-off flows.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Oil and broad commodities powering risk tone: USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND; copper CPER (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND signals industrial bid. Gold GLD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.54%) RECOVERY — safe-haven interest but profit-taking over month.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND with oil ETFs USO/BNO surging ABOVE TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -7.74%) RECOVERY and remains volatile.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
Confirmed strength in Energy/commodities (XLE, BNO, USO ABOVE TREND) and Utilities/Industrials (XLU/XLI ABOVE TREND). Major divergence present: SPY, XLK and XLF show 1W vs 1M mismatches (MAJOR DIVERGENCE) — suppress strong directional bets and prefer selectivity.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor exposure to energy and cyclical commodity proxies (XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor GLD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.54%) RECOVERY; reduce exposure to momentum/tech names showing weakness (XLK (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) RECOVERY, QQQ (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -3.04%) BELOW TREND) and keep bond positioning cautious given TLT (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -3.16%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +9.03%) ABOVE TREND if oil ETFs USO/BNO remain >1W gains. BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) RECOVERY and Discretionary XLY likely vulnerable if breadth stays narrow.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Crude ETFs USO (1W: +16.92% | 1M: +25.37%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +25.65%) ABOVE TREND for continued cyclical impulse. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: +1.82% | 1M: -7.74%) RECOVERY remains range-risky on monthly weakness.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX 20 (complacency) — VXX (1W: +4.99% | 1M: -5.66%) RECOVERY. HYG/LQD spread threshold ~0.80 — HYG (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.34%) BELOW TREND, LQD (1W: -1.15% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND. XLK/XLF pivot — watch XLK (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -3.12%) RECOVERY vs XLF (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +3.62%) CORRECTION.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, with Energy/Utilities/Industrials showing the clearest strength. Key risk is the MAJOR DIVERGENCE across core ETFs (SPY, XLK, XLF) that argues for selectivity and monitoring of credit/bond flow dynamics.
